root=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = grid[0].index(2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if r <= center and (c == center-r or c == center+r):
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif (c-r-(center-4)) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
